steps.content: The path you came from has been completely sealed off. You search every corner of the inn and find no way to reopen it.
Clearly, you can't get out the way you came. You take a moment to think.

Since you were able to wake up again at the hot spring inn, it means that this extremely realistic fictional world has a functional resurrection mechanism in place. If that's the case, as an NPC, Prima might also respawn at a fixed location.
You leave the hot spring inn and plunge into the darkness of night.
Following the remembered path, you head straight for the place where you first met Prima. As you round the familiar tree, your eyes catch a shadow.
Hey, dude! Guess you've found me!
steps.female_content: Hey there! Guess you've found me!

steps.content: The owner of the voice turns around, revealing an overly cheerful grin, with a familiar long ax resting on his shoulder.
[Flashback: The Butcher attacking you in the previous cycle]
